summary.overview: India's Constitution (adopted 26 Jan 1950) defines fundamental civic duties under Article 51A, mandating environmental and wildlife protection. India displays rich cultural diversity in headgear (phetas, topis) and regional languages (shown on currency panels). Dedicated conservation at Gir Forest in Gujarat saved the endangered Asiatic lion.
